title: Dr Frost Arctic Blueberry Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Nic Salt Blueberry Raspberry Ice combines the juicy sweetness of Blueberries with the tart and tangy flavour of ripe Raspberries, perfectly finished with a bracing wave of menthol on the exhale. This deeply fruity and refreshing e-liquid delivers a well-balanced fruit flavour profile with a cool, crisp exhale, ideal for vapers who enjoy layered, fruity blends with a frosty finish. As part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid features a double-concentrated Bar Salts flavour, designed to replicate the bold and intense taste associated with disposable vapes. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s perfect for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits and low-powered devices, providing smooth throat hits and fast-acting nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Blueberry Raspberry Ice offers a versatile option for adult smokers and vapers seeking fruity flavours with an icy twist.
